data.title: 白面鸮 · 三分钟茶
data.description: 沙漏里的最后一点细沙落下，她才取出茶包，平静地宣布泡茶完成。
data.promptProse: In a streamlined break room, Ptilopsis sits before a sleek counter observing the final fine grains of sand descend through a brass hourglass. A steaming cup of black tea and a minimalist ceramic teapot rest on a pristine cork coaster under cool fluorescent lights.
data.animaCaption: Her eyes track the very last sand grain slipping through the hourglass neck before she calmly lifts the teapot to serve.
